lane: Mobile share cards v2 follow-up. Owner approved on 28/11/2026: 'Đồng ý Sửa 2 lỗi bố cục thẻ Bản đồ số 4:5 và thêm `.claude/` vào `.easignore` luôn.'
goal: Fix the two layout bugs found on the phone (EAS 2b10c936) on the Bản đồ số 4:5 share card: the header eyebrow nearly touching the SỐ CHỦ ĐẠO label, and the number chips touching the divider above the QR. Add .claude/ to the root .easignore so EAS archives from the main checkout stay under 2 GB.
successCriteria: Numerology 4:5 card: a clear gap (at least 10 design units) between the header eyebrow and the SỐ CHỦ ĐẠO label, and between the chips row and the QR divider; content never overlaps the frame.
Story format and the other skins keep their layout (only spacing in the numbers body and the header-to-body gap change).
Root .easignore ignores .claude/ (local worktrees and agent state); the release-candidate tests still pass.
tsc and the share tests pass.
untouchedSurfaces: Card content, QR address, share events and web pages are unchanged.
No SQL, Edge Function, EAS, Vercel or Cloudflare setting change.
The Tarot share landing redesign is a proposal document only; no web or app code for it in this PR.
